Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of the Work 1. Pulling out the 137120 policy dockets (Approx) /430 BATCHES (Approx) i.e.( 4200 to 4400 Flat Files ) of Incremental batches from racks placed at LIC RMF centre in Bhinder Teh. Vallabhnagar Dt.Udaipur a s per Policy number wise list provided in hard copy. 2. After pulling out of dockets it is to be handed over to LIC officials in 100-100 dockets per bundle tied wi th rope for verification at spe cified places. 3. Pulling of incremental flat files as per the list provided in hard copy and placing them batch wise for Verification by EDMS officials of the corporation. 4. Verified dockets and incremental flat files are to be placed in proper place as per our requirement withi n aforementioned premis es. 5. Segregation of brown paper from documents and verified policy dockets and incremental files. 6. Tearing of segregated documents from policy dockets and flat incremental files. 7. Shredding the torn documents into small pieces /mechanically shredded to be kept in bags/ bori , same will be arranged by vendor only. 8. The entire job of pulling, segregating, tearing and shredding is to be completed within 30 days else a pe nalty of Rs. 500/-per day will be charged (maximum penalty Rs 10000/-) 9. Empty dockets shall be packed in bags in bundle of 1000 dockets. Bags will have to be provided by the vendor. 10. Rearranging of balance dockets as per our requirement in racks. 11. Corporation reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of dockets by 25% at any time

during the urgency of the contract. Successful bidder is bound to accept the orders accordingly than payment shall be made on pro rata basis. 12. For any clarification on the scope of work the bidder should contact to Manager EDMS on Mob.no. 9414060904, AO EDMS- 9414233593. I/we agree with all terms and conditions. Seal and sign of the tenderer 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of LIC OF INDIA payable at AT UDAIPUR . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
